MINI MINUTES: Appearances: Attorney for plaintiff: Dolores Chong, Attorney for Defendant: Daniel Bailey, Also present: Plaintiffs Dick and Jasmine Mak, Defendant Calvin Schneiter.
Parties agree to the following: A mutual release of all claims with one exception-damage to the basement-not waived. Each side to bear its own costs and fees. A new lease agreement will be drawn. 4 years to start 11/1/04 @ $8500 due 1st of the month, every month, with an option term of 6 more years. Rent to be paid by the 5th of each month or considered late. Parties will attempt to set up electronic payment system. There will be a 5% increase each year of remaining 4 years; during option period a 3% increase. Defendant will pay back rent of $41,516 by 10/25/04. Security deposit due in the amount of $25,500. Landlord has a previous security deposit from defendant. Defendant will augment it to bring it up to $25,000.

Lease conditional on additional terms: 1)Defendant pays rent late(not by the 5th of the month)3 times in any 12 months, not respective of a calendar year. 2)Defendant to pay 1/3 property taxes each year. 3) Defendant will pay PG&E-anything over $50 a month. 4) Tenant may not bring any liens against the property.

1) Storefront: Defendant may not install any equipment without prermission of the landlord.
2) Defendant to have proof of insurance.
3) $250 late fee for late rent.
4) Defendant to pay back damages in the amount of $30,000, $10K by 1/1/05, $10K by 4/1/05,
$10K by 7/1/05.
Plaintiffs will give consent to use of liquor license on the premises. Lease to be made in duplicate originals. No subletting.
